findings.description: Legend markers (diamond, square, X, dashed line) and the text are fully displayed, with no clipping or overlap; the spacing between the title, parameters and legend is adequate. In the grayscale version, the legend entries remain distinguishable by marker shape and line style.

The y-axis label sqrt(h) I_S''(ξ_M - h) (fm^2) and the tick labels 0.0675-0.0705 are complete and not cut off; the curve, the independent threshold dashed line and the square/X markers are clearly visible, and the leftmost X marker is slightly above the dashed line and can still be identified.

The y-axis label Q_log(h) (fm^2) and the tick labels 0.0420-0.0450 are complete; the leftmost square marker (green open square) and the X marker are separated from the curve, and the platform near 0.044 and the deviation at the leftmost end are clearly identifiable in both the color and grayscale versions.

In grayscale, the green square becomes an open square, and the black X remains an X, so the two can still be distinguished; the diamond curve remains clearly visible. The dashed threshold line has moderate contrast with the curve at the platform, and the slight deviation of the leftmost X marker in the bottom panel is still discernible.
The tick labels 10^-6, 10^-5, 10^-4 and the label h = |ξ - ξ_M| (Mott limit toward left) are fully displayed, with no clipping from the bottom margin.

answer.visible_behavior: In the upper panel the curve rises smoothly from left to right; the square and X markers nearly coincide with the curve, but the X markers can still be identified. In the lower panel, h decreases toward the left: the curve rises from the leftmost diamond to the platform, the leftmost square (green open square) is clearly below the curve, and the more-left X marker is at the top near the dashed line. The platform segment is close to the threshold dashed line, and the deviation at the leftmost end is visible in both the color and grayscale versions. The legend, axis labels and tick labels are not clipped or overlapping.
answer.uncertainty: The square and X markers are large and nearly overlap with the curve in some places; in the grayscale version the leftmost X marker in the bottom panel and the dashed line are close in brightness, and at small display sizes the symbol shapes may be somewhat mixed up. The exact matching of individual marker points to their coordinates depends on numerical values, but no data have been moved (it is impossible to determine whether the coincidence is caused by truly close values). Future adjustments to symbol outlines or marker sizes may improve grayscale legibility further.
